accepted_obligation: U_LOCAL/U_MASS/U_TOTAL/U_INDUCT: determine whether the current route/Float64/path mechanism can be completed into one deterministic total Independent-Set decider from encoded input x alone under one fixed polynomial total-work bound
inherited_contracts: Encoded input length n=|x| remains the complexity variable
needed_inputs: Exact fixed encoding of x=(G,K) and n=|x| under the existing charter
Exact definition of the proposed Float64/coordinate/path representation, including finite-precision or exact-arithmetic semantics actually claimed
Deterministic procedure that constructs that representation from x, rather than assuming it is supplied
Deterministic route/path selector from the constructed state, including how failure/no-route states are represented
Exact terminal YES/NO rule preserving Independent-Set semantics
Witness/certificate role: supplied, constructed, recovered, or unused
Original-ID witness reconstruction procedure if a YES witness is claimed
Lifecycle cost terms required by REQ-0007-COST-MASS
requested_parts: One finite deterministic candidate algorithm A taking only encoded input x
Exact proof obligation for A(x)=L(x) on every valid Independent-Set input
Exact proof obligation that A halts with YES or NO on every valid input
Exact construction rule from x to any Float64/coordinate/path state used by A
Exact route-selection rule with no hidden DeanSelection-equivalent oracle
If a certificate y is used, explicit separation between checking supplied y and constructing/finding y from x
One symbolic total-work recurrence W(n) covering representation construction, discovery, routing, transforms, reconciliation, verification, rollback, recovery, and witness reconstruction
One fixed candidate c,k for T_A(n) <= c*n^k+c, or an explicit unresolved/failure witness showing why that bound is not yet established
N->N+1 preservation argument, if used, for the same finite A and the same fixed exponent k
counterprobes: A polynomial verifier for supplied y is presented without a polynomial procedure that finds/constructs y or decides from x alone
A route/index is treated as known without charging deterministic discovery from x
Float64 or finite-precision coordinates alias two encoded states whose Independent-Set decisions or required continuations differ
A real-number or infinite-precision operation hides unbounded information or unit-cost arithmetic not present in the fixed deterministic model
Representation dimension/path length is used as the complexity variable without a proved and charged polynomial relation to n=|x|
An exponentially large certificate/path/search space is traversed implicitly through preprocessing, recursion, branching, table construction, or recovery
The exponent, machine, advice, preprocessing, or route family changes with n, K, graph family, deficit, depth, or selected path
The mechanism returns only YES witnesses and lacks an exact terminating NO rule
The mechanism preserves a heuristic/high-low coordinate objective but not exact Independent-Set language semantics
Local polynomial transitions compose into superpolynomial total work
acceptance_criteria: The candidate is one deterministic finite algorithm A whose only external problem input is the fixed encoding x
A(x)=L(x) is proved for every valid Independent-Set input, including exact YES and NO behavior
Every representation, route, certificate, and reconstruction object used by A is constructed or obtained by an explicitly charged deterministic operation
All lifecycle work is bounded by one fixed polynomial in n=|x| with constants/exponent independent of input family, K, depth, route, or size
Any N->N+1 argument preserves the same A and same fixed exponent
REQ-0008-REFEREE counterprobes find no verifier-to-constructor, known-route, representation, totality, or cost-bound promotion gap
Until all criteria are met, the result remains scoped or UNRESOLVED and P ?= NP remains OPEN

cost_envelope.complexity_variable: n=|x| under the fixed encoded input

output_contract: Return either (a) one fully specified candidate deterministic decider plus the exact proof obligations/cost recurrence needed for admission, or (b) the first explicit missing bridge/failure witness. Do not promote fast verification, known routes, or Float64/path structure by themselves.
remainder: This request does not itself prove P=NP. The next admissible move is to instantiate A and attack the first missing bridge under the same fixed definitions.
